results.title: Hogg happy with the 'intent and attitude' of Cobblers on opening day
results.description: Chris Hogg praised his side’s ‘attitude, effort and intent’ and said they have given themselves a solid platform to build on for the rest of the season after Saturday’s opening day 0-0 draw with Swindon Town.

results.title: Pre-Read Book Discussion for Staff: Reader, Come Home
results.description: Staff across the University are invited to a book discussion of this year’s Pre-Read, Reader, Come Home: The Reading Brain in A Digital World by Maryanne Wolf. The discussion will be led by Corina Bardoff, Manager of Events & Programing at the Commons Library. Staff are encouraged (but not required) to think of a question about Reader, Come Home for the group to discuss. You are welcome to bring your lunch, snacks, or a drink. Learn more about the Pre-Read and request a copy: https://president.princeton.edu/princeton-pre-read.
